protocol.physical_seed_rule: Native rank0/local_seed1 ep0,1,2 gives seeds1,2,3; fresh environment per branch, global setup seed1
protocol.goal: Unmodified native separate-expert final visual/proprio after100 controls; expert action sequence is archived only
protocol.noop: Physical float32 [0,0,0,0], not normalized zero; two complete99-control repeats
protocol.servo_inputs: Only raw float32 current and goal proprio of shape(4); xyz used, fourth element ignored
protocol.straight_servo: Frozen reach comparator: clip(float32(5)*(goal_xyz-current_xyz),-1,1), gripper0; collision-unaware, not official wall expert
protocol.wall_aware_servo: Same P5/gripper0 with public desired-position rule: if -.1<=x<=.3 and .60<=y<=.80 and z<.25, desired=goal_xyz+[0,0,1], else desired=goal_xyz
protocol.wall_aware_prior: Uses public fixed wall geometry prior; uses supplied expert-goal proprio instead of hidden environment target. Not full official expert: feedback is latched at7 boundaries and goal is observed endpoint
protocol.servo_arithmetic: float32; clip xyz to[-1,1] before environment; fixed action for15x6+9 controls
protocol.primary_success: Final native info.success at environment step100; TCP-target distance<=.05; done_at_succ=False
protocol.cpu_model_loading: Instantiate released checkpoint and local DINO encoder on CPU; force strict=True for every load_state_dict; no forward

future_native_gpu.precision: FP32, native full300 candidate batch; no autocast/microbatch or retraining
future_native_gpu.macro_action: 20D = five4D controls; frameskip5/action_skip1; native last planned10 truncated to9
future_native_gpu.cem_rng: One native GC_Agent generator seeded1 across fixed seeds1,2,3 in order
future_native_gpu.execution: Not implemented/launched by this CPU prerequisites script; any later adapter must bind this registration and all CPU artifacts

protocol.failure_rule: No retries, seed replacement, gain/goal/threshold tuning or longer budget. Preserve each scheduled branch and error. Prerequisite errors block GPU; all fixed CPU branches may still be collected once without selection.

gate.cpu_mathematical_stop: If wall-aware or noop has>=2/3 final successes, native<=3/3 cannot clear the net+2 gate; stop panel GPU with native unmeasured, not failed
gate.runtime_or_pairing_failure: Incomplete/invalid prerequisites, never counted as native task failure
gate.scope: Fixed three-seed descriptive normal-capability/resource screen, not statistical confirmation, pure forecast causality, attack or defense evidence
gate.stop_rule: No new task/seed selection or budget changes to obtain a passing panel; all prior failed gates remain unchanged

setup.goal_source: native separate-env expert final image/proprio; expert controls are archived but never provided to CEM
